items.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
items.summary: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

items.title: Bitcion tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
items.summary: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

items.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
items.summary: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

items.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
items.summary: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

items.title: Crypto for Advisors: Where investors stake crypto shapes how much of the reward they keep
Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
items.summary: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
items.summary: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

items.title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
items.summary: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

items.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
items.summary: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

items.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
items.summary: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

items.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
items.summary: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
items.summary: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

items.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
items.summary: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

items.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
items.summary: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

items.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
items.summary: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

items.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
items.summary: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

items.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
items.summary: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

items.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
items.summary: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

items.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
items.summary: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

items.title: Claude Gets Personal Finance—Anthony Pompliano Accuses Anthropic of Copying His Startup
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude finance assistant analyzes spending from linked accounts in the U.S., and Anthony Pompliano has a big problem with it.

items.title: Bitcoin Fixes This? Paraguay President Resigns After Bank Lockout Hits 60% of Country
items.summary: Ueno’s collapse trapped millions of Paraguayan depositors and triggered a president’s resignation, reviving Bitcoin’s argument for self-custody.

items.title: OpenAI Promises to Foot AI’s Power Bill After Voter Revolt. Who Enforces It?
items.summary: OpenAI wants to ease the backlash against AI campuses with promises on electricity, water and secrecy. Its new compact raises a tougher question: Who would make the company comply?

items.title: DOJ Creates 'Super Intelligence' Task Force to Guard Against AI Abuse
items.summary: Led by two senior DOJ officials, the Super Intelligence Task Force will target misuse by foreign governments, criminal groups and fraudsters—while pushing AI developers to tighten internal controls so their systems “beha

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
items.summary: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

items.title: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
items.summary: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.

items.title: OpenAI Found 948 Linux Security Flaws—And Figured Out How to Exploit Them
items.summary: An automated OpenAI system produced working exploits and draft fixes at roughly $1,279 per flaw, raising new questions about how cheaply AI can find holes in critical software at scale.

items.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Turns a Profit as Bitcoin Rise Lifts Books
items.summary: The Hut 8-backed miner reversed a second-quarter loss, driven largely by a $197 million gain on its Bitcoin holdings.

items.title: S&amp;#038;P 500 Plunges, Wall Street Fears Circuit Breaker, Just One Day After Trump Celebrated Record Highs
items.summary: A day after Trump celebrated stock market records, the S&amp;P 500 sank 3.8%, putting emergency trading halts in focus as AI stocks dragged Wall Street sharply lower during Thursday trading.

items.title: Hollywood Studios Quietly Ban Staff From Betting on Prediction Markets: Report
items.summary: Employees are being told not to bet on casting news, release dates or earnings, though experts say the rules will be hard to enforce.
